create_RetrievalVis: create a RetrievalVis instance to set up an HTML webpage directory for visualizing retrieval results
visualize_ranking: call visualize_ranking to generate an HTML page showing top-k video retrieval rankings for a given epoch
display_current_results: call display_current_results to render retrieval rankings with R1, R5, R10, and MedR metrics into an HTML report
mkdirs: create multiple directories at once by passing a list of paths to the mkdirs utility function
mkdir: create a single directory if it does not already exist using the mkdir utility function
